de.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation (the factor R's ``mad()`` and so cellHTS2 apply). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01), kept so the residuals agree with the B-score cellHTS2 computes.
de.translation: Die Konstanten: ``MAD_SCALE`` ist ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, womit die MAD einer normalverteilten Stichprobe deren Standardabweichung schätzt (der Faktor, den ``mad()`` in R und damit cellHTS2 anwenden). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` sind ``mm`` (Momentenmethode), ``umvue`` (gleichmäßig minimale Varianz, erwartungstreu) und ``robust`` (Median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` beträgt 3 für jede Statistik: SSMD 3 ist Zhangs "strong" Effekt, und 3 robuste Sigma sind die übliche Grenze für robustes z und den B-Score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` und ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` sind die Standardwerte von ``medpolish`` in R (10 und 0.01), beibehalten, damit die Residuen mit dem von cellHTS2 berechneten B-Score übereinstimmen.

es.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation (the factor R's ``mad()`` and so cellHTS2 apply). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01), kept so the residuals agree with the B-score cellHTS2 computes.
es.translation: Las constantes: ``MAD_SCALE`` es ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, que hace que la MAD de una muestra normal estime su desviación típica (el factor que aplican ``mad()`` de R y, por tanto, cellHTS2). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` son ``mm`` (método de los momentos), ``umvue`` (insesgado de varianza uniformemente mínima) y ``robust`` (mediana/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` vale 3 para todos los estadísticos: SSMD 3 es el efecto "strong" de Zhang, y 3 sigmas robustas es el corte habitual para la z robusta y la puntuación B. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` y ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` son los valores por defecto de ``medpolish`` de R (10 y 0.01), mantenidos para que los residuos coincidan con la puntuación B que calcula cellHTS2.

hi.translation: स्थिरांक: ``MAD_SCALE`` ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826 है, जिससे किसी सामान्य नमूने का MAD उसके मानक विचलन का आकलन करता है (वह गुणक जो R का ``mad()`` और इसलिए cellHTS2 लगाते हैं)। ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` हैं ``mm`` (आघूर्ण-विधि), ``umvue`` (समान रूप से न्यूनतम प्रसरण वाला अनभिनत) और ``robust`` (माध्यिका/MAD, SSMD*)। ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` हर आँकड़े के लिए 3 है: SSMD 3 Zhang का "strong" प्रभाव है, और 3 रोबस्ट सिग्मा रोबस्ट z और B-स्कोर के लिए सामान्य कट-ऑफ़ है। ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` और ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` R के ``medpolish`` के डिफ़ॉल्ट (10 और 0.01) हैं, जिन्हें इसलिए रखा गया है ताकि अवशेष cellHTS2 द्वारा गणना किए गए B-स्कोर से मेल खाएँ।

ko.translation: 상수: ``MAD_SCALE`` 은 ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826 으로, 정규 표본의 MAD 가 표준 편차를 추정하게 합니다(R 의 ``mad()`` 와 그에 따라 cellHTS2 가 적용하는 계수). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` 는 ``mm``(적률법), ``umvue``(균일 최소 분산 불편) 및 ``robust``(중앙값/MAD, SSMD*)입니다. ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` 는 모든 통계량에서 3 입니다. pt.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation (the factor R's ``mad()`` and so cellHTS2 apply). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01), kept so the residuals agree with the B-score cellHTS2 computes.
pt.translation: As constantes: ``MAD_SCALE`` é ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, o que faz a MAD de uma amostra normal estimar o seu desvio-padrão (o fator que ``mad()`` do R e, portanto, o cellHTS2 aplicam). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` são ``mm`` (método dos momentos), ``umvue`` (não viesado de variância uniformemente mínima) e ``robust`` (mediana/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` vale 3 para toda estatística: SSMD 3 é o efeito "strong" de Zhang, e 3 sigmas robustos é o corte usual para o z robusto e o escore B. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` e ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` são os padrões de ``medpolish`` do R (10 e 0.01), mantidos para que os resíduos concordem com o escore B que o cellHTS2 calcula.

sv.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation (the factor R's ``mad()`` and so cellHTS2 apply). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01), kept so the residuals agree with the B-score cellHTS2 computes.
sv.translation: Konstanterna: ``MAD_SCALE`` är ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, vilket gör att MAD för ett normalfördelat urval skattar dess standardavvikelse (den faktor som R:s ``mad()`` och därmed cellHTS2 använder). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` är ``mm`` (momentmetoden), ``umvue`` (likformigt minimal varians, väntevärdesriktig) och ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` är 3 för varje statistik: SSMD 3 är Zhangs "strong" effekt, och 3 robusta sigma är den vanliga gränsen för robust z och B-poängen. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` och ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` är standardvärdena för R:s ``medpolish`` (10 och 0.01), behållna så att residualerna stämmer med den B-poäng som cellHTS2 beräknar.

zh_CN.source: The constants: ``MAD_SCALE`` is ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826, which makes the MAD of a normal sample estimate its standard deviation (the factor R's ``mad()`` and so cellHTS2 apply). ``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` are ``mm`` (method of moments), ``umvue`` (uniformly minimal variance unbiased) and ``robust`` (median/MAD, SSMD*). ``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` are 3 for every statistic: SSMD 3 is Zhang's "strong" effect, and 3 robust sigma is the usual cut-off for robust z and the B-score. ``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` and ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` are R's ``medpolish`` defaults (10 and 0.01), kept so the residuals agree with the B-score cellHTS2 computes.
zh_CN.translation: 常量：``MAD_SCALE`` 为 ``1 / Phi^-1(0.75)`` = 1.4826，使正态样本的 MAD 能估计其标准差（这是 R 的 ``mad()`` 以及 cellHTS2 所用的系数）。``SSMD_ESTIMATORS`` 为 ``mm``（矩估计法）、``umvue``（一致最小方差无偏）和 ``robust``（中位数/MAD，SSMD*）。``DEFAULT_HIT_THRESHOLDS`` 对每种统计量都是 3：SSMD 3 是 Zhang 所说的 "strong" 效应，3 个稳健 sigma 是稳健 z 和 B 分数的常用临界值。``MEDIAN_POLISH_MAX_ITER`` 和 ``MEDIAN_POLISH_EPS`` 是 R 的 ``medpolish`` 默认值（10 和 0.01），保留它们是为了让残差与 cellHTS2 计算的 B 分数一致。
